stem: A network performance study measures the download speed (Mbps) for a sample of 40 subscribers. The sample mean is 428.0 Mbps with a sample standard deviation of 144.0 Mbps. Assuming the data are approximately normally distributed, estimate the true population mean and provide a 95% confidence interval.

ground_truth.answer: Population mean ≈ 428.0 Mbps. 95% CI = [381.9, 474.1]. Point estimate: 428.0 Mbps.

common_failure_modes: Using z-critical value instead of t-critical for small samples
Not reporting the confidence interval alongside the point estimate
